name: Runemaster Earthen Codex makes the next 3 attacks after a Palm Sigil crit for 20% more (#1266)
contract: Earthen Codex 707460 (Riftblade talent, CharacterAdvancement 6478) reads 'When you active a Palm Sigil, you are
now guaranteed to critically strike for $707730s2% increased critical damage for $707730d or your next 3
attacks.' Its only effect is aura 42 naming 707730, but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row
existed, so it never fired. 707730 (SpellDuration 1 = 10000 ms) carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290)
BasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100 and SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% for
MiscValue 126 (all magic schools). Every Palm Sigil (Fire 534803-534807, Earth 805382, Arcane 805380/807322/
807323, Water 500639, Frost 805381, Wind 807013) carries SpellFamilyName 38 and SpellFamilyFlags word 2
0x2000; they need the Runeshroud marker 808089. Expected: activating Palm Sigil: Earth with the talent
applies 707730 for 10 sec with 3 charges; the critical strike chance of Primordial Blast 800732 (magic, school
28) against the enemy is at least 100 and its critical damage on a 1000 base (1500) rises by exactly 20% to
1800; each of the next three landed Primordial Blasts is a critical strike and spends one charge, and the third
removes the buff. The same sigil without the talent grants nothing.
